f_title: Everything an agency needs to sell AI customer service
f_lead: One dashboard to run every client, and a portal for each of them.
f1: The AI answers and a person steps in when needed. Pause the agent, reply, and hand control back.
f2: Each client sees its conversations, contacts and reports on its own domain, with its logo and colors.
f3: PDFs, Q&A pairs and catalogs, with semantic search so the agent finds the right answer.
f4: The agent collects name, email and phone, follows up when a contact goes quiet and keeps to business hours.
f5: An agent that picks up the client's phone with a natural voice and hands over to a person.
f6: Conversations resolved by AI, response times and cost per client, ready to show.
a_title: Built for teams that serve other businesses
a1: Add a monthly AI customer service retainer to your current clients and bill each one.
a2: Deploy agents for clinics, real estate, stores and schools without building your own platform.
a3: Run each brand or branch on its own, with its data kept apart, from one team.
sec_title: Each client's data, kept apart and protected
sec_lead: Agentaria is designed for agencies that handle other businesses' information.
c1: Each client has its own space: agents, knowledge and conversations never mix.
c2: AI keys and WhatsApp sessions are stored encrypted and never reach the browser.
c3: Owner, admin, operator and viewer. Require 2FA for your whole team.
c4: Connect your clients' numbers through Meta's official API.
c5: The database is backed up automatically every day.
c6: On Enterprise, your own isolated installation, in the data region you need.
pr_lead: Pay for the clients you serve. Every plan includes every channel and the branded portal.
pr_note: Prices in USD. AI model and WhatsApp usage is billed separately at the provider's price, with your own keys or prepaid credit.
q1: Do I need to know how to code?
a1q: No. You create agents with a wizard, upload documents and connect channels from the dashboard.
a2q: Use your own keys for providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or OpenRouter, or prepaid credit. Reports show the cost per client so you can bill it on.
q3: Does it work with official WhatsApp?
a3q: Yes. We recommend Meta's official Cloud API for each number. You can also link a number by QR code for testing.
a4q: They don't have to. Their portal shows their logo and colors and can run on their own domain.
q5: What if the AI can't answer?
a5q: It escalates the conversation to a person on your team under the rules you set, and sends a notification.
q6: What happens when the trial ends?
a6q: Pick a plan to continue. Otherwise your account is paused and your data is kept for 30 days.
cta_title: Start selling AI customer service this month
cta_lead: We'll help you set up your first client on a call.
